knowledge:
- key_parameters: internal=set to TRUE in faers_meta() to use the package's internal metadata copy instead of parsing the live FDA website ;; dir=the directory path where FAERS quarterly data files are stored or should be downloaded ;; compress_dir=the temporary directory used for uncompressing downloaded files ;; meddra_path=the path to the uncompressed MedDRA data directory required for standardization ;; use=specifies which MedDRA component to retrieve in faers_meddra() (e.g., "hierarchy") ;; .fn=a filtering function passed to faers_filter() that must return the primaryid vector of reports to keep ;; .field=the specific data field (e.g., "drug") to apply the filter function to ;; .full=the background distribution data (usually the entire FAERS dataset) passed to faers_phv_signal() ;; .events=the column name containing the events of interest (default is "soc_name") in faers_phv_signal() ;; BPPARAM=parallel execution parameters passed to faers_phv_signal()
- alternatives: None mentioned in the documentation.
- when_to_use: Use when performing post-marketing drug safety monitoring, pharmacovigilance analysis, and safety signal detection using FDA FAERS quarterly data.
- pitfalls: Duplicate and incomplete reports are a major limitation of the FAERS database; users must run faers_dedup() to handle identical cases. XML format currently receives only minimal support compared to the default ASCII format. Users must replace placeholder paths like meddra_path with their own uncompressed MedDRA data path to standardize the data.

workflows.name: faers_pharmacovigilance_analysis
workflows.intent: Download, preprocess, standardize, de-duplicate, and perform pharmacovigilance signal detection on FAERS quarterly data.
workflows.stages: 1. Check FAERS metadata using faers_meta() ;; 2. Download and parse quarterly data files using faers() ;; 3. Retrieve specific field data using faers_get() ;; 4. Standardize terminology with MedDRA using faers_standardize() ;; 5. Retrieve MedDRA hierarchy information using faers_meddra() ;; 6. De-duplicate reports using faers_dedup() ;; 7. Filter for drugs of interest (e.g., insulin) using fda_drugs() and faers_filter() ;; 8. Perform pharmacovigilance signal analysis using faers_phv_signal()
workflows.code:
faers_meta(internal = TRUE)
data1 <- faers(2004, "q1",
    dir = system.file("extdata", package = "faers"),
    compress_dir = tempdir()
)
data1
data2 <- faers(c(2004, 2017), c("q1", "q2"),
    dir = system.file("extdata", package = "faers"),
    compress_dir = tempdir()
)
data2
faers_get(data2, "demo")
# data <- faers_standardize(data2, meddra_path)
data <- readRDS(system.file("extdata", "standardized_data.rds", package = "faers"))
data
faers_meddra(data)
faers_meddra(data, use = "hierarchy")
faers_get(data, "indi")
faers_get(data, "reac")
data <- faers_dedup(data)
data
insulin_names <- "insulin"
insulin_pattern <- paste(insulin_names, collapse = "|")
fda_insulin <- fda_drugs()[
    grepl(insulin_pattern, ActiveIngredient, ignore.case = TRUE)
]
insulin_pattern <- paste0(
    unique(tolower(c(insulin_names, fda_insulin$DrugName))),
    collapse = "|"
)
insulin_data <- faers_filter(data, .fn = function(x) {
    idx <- grepl(insulin_pattern, x$drugname, ignore.case = TRUE) |
        grepl(insulin_pattern, x$prod_ai, ignore.case = TRUE)
    x[idx, primaryid]
}, .field = "drug")
insulin_data
insulin_signals <- faers_phv_signal(insulin_data,
    .full = data,
    BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = 1L)
)
insulin_signals
insulin_signals_hlgt <- faers_phv_signal(
    insulin_data,
    .events = "hlgt_name", .full = data,
    BPPARAM = BiocParallel::SerialParam(RNGseed = 1L)
)
insulin_signals_hlgt
